section: Safety hazard: mechanical parts of the appliance
markdown:
| Danger                                                                   | Where or in what situations does the hazard arise?                               | Preventative action                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Risk of body parts being crushed if the appliance tips over or falls off | When the appliance is being moved e.g., to gain better access to the connections | Ensure oven is level and stable Always observe the requirements for the supporting surface when taking the appliance out of service; see section 3 'For your safety' in the conneX ® Installation and User manual |
| Risk of slipping on damp kitchen floor                                   | In front of the appliance                                                        | Ensure that the floor around the appliance is dry at all times                                                                                                                                                    |
